status.description: The status of the rule. Rules can be enabled or disabled.

ruleType.description: The type of rule. In this case IFTTT. See the Ably integrations docs for further information.

requestMode.description: Single request mode sends each event separately to the endpoint specified by the rule. You can read more about single request mode events in the batching docs.

webhookKey.description: The key in the Webhook Service Documentation page of your IFTTT account.

eventName.description: The Event name is used to identify the IFTTT applet that will receive the Event, make sure the name matches the name of the IFTTT applet.
